summary: node1 now serves a persistent local DNF repository over HTTP. tree-1.8.0-10.el9 was installed from it while AppStream, BaseOS, and Extras were unreachable. Repository service, payload, metadata, installed package, and transaction provenance all survived the required reboot.
actions_performed: Created /var/www/html/localrepo with signed tree RPM and repository metadata.
Configured local-storage at http://10.100.222.10/localrepo/ and enabled Apache at boot.
Forced standard repository endpoints to an unreachable port during the installation test.
Installed tree from local-storage and verified transaction provenance.
Restarted node1 once and verified persistence and recovery.

evidence.requirement: Serve a package repository from local storage
evidence.summary: Apache serves valid repository metadata and the signed RPM over node1's managed IP; DNF indexes tree as repo=local-storage before and after reboot.

evidence.requirement: Install a package while usual remote repositories are unreachable
evidence.summary: AppStream, BaseOS, and Extras failed with connection refusals; DNF ignored them and successfully installed tree from local-storage. History records @local-storage.

Healthy baseline used boot ID a4139d3b-4eba-4628-807d-d5a84aa5c913; reboot was acknowledged; node returned with boot ID f9f3d862-614b-4b6e-b3dc-66cfa8281738; Apache, repository metadata and payload, DNF indexing, installed tree package, and transaction history recovered.
